content.text:
The drawing is a fragment with two wavy-line attachment points, so each end is written as *.

Reading left to right:
- The left wavy line attaches to a carbonyl carbon, C(=O).
- That carbonyl carbon is bonded to NH.
- The NH is followed by CH2CH2.
- The chain then reaches a second NH.
- The second NH is bonded to a carbonyl carbon, C(=O), which carries the right wavy line.

This gives *C(=O)NCCNC(=O)*.

SMILES: *C(=O)NCCNC(=O)*
